reference_checks.check: When a seller with at least 60 coins opens their Available listing in an eligible category, taps 'Promote', selects '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)', and confirms purchase, the bump's price (30 or 60 coins respectively) is deducted immediately from the seller's wallet.

After a seller with at least 60 coins purchases either '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)' on an Available listing in an eligible category, the listing page displays the remaining promotion time.

After purchasing either '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)' on an Available listing in an eligible category, the listing appears in the top 3 search positions for its category when viewed as a buyer.

After purchasing either '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)' on an Available listing in an eligible category, the listing displays a 'Promoted' badge in category search results when viewed as a buyer.
When a seller with 20 coins taps 'Promote' on an Available listing and selects '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)', the purchase is blocked.
When a seller with 20 coins taps 'Promote' on an Available listing and selects '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)', the seller is prompted to top up coins.
When a seller navigates to a Reserved listing and checks the 'Promote' option, the Reserved listing cannot be promoted.
When a seller navigates to a Sold listing and checks the 'Promote' option, the Sold listing cannot be promoted.
When a seller navigates to an Available listing in a Trust & Safety restricted category and checks the 'Promote' option, the restricted-category listing cannot be promoted.
When time advances past an active 3-day Bump promotion duration, the 'Promoted' label is removed from the listing in search results.
When time advances past an active 3-day Bump promotion duration, the listing returns to organic search ranking in search results.
When the seller views the listing stats card on their listing page after a 3-day Bump expires, it compares views and chats during the 3-day promotion against the prior 3-day period.

checklist_items.item: Promote entry point is available on the seller's own listing.
3-day Bump package is available for 30 coins.
7-day Bump package is available for 60 coins.
Coins are deducted immediately upon purchasing a promotion package.
Insufficient coin balance triggers a top-up prompt when attempting to promote.
Promoted listing appears in the top 3 positions of its category's search results.
Promoted listing rotates with other promoted listings in the top 3 positions of its category's search results.
'Promoted' label is shown on the listing card in search results.
Time remaining on the active promotion is visible to the seller on their listing page.
On promotion expiry, the listing returns to normal search ranking.
On promotion expiry, the 'Promoted' label is removed from the listing card.
Only Available listings can be promoted (non-Available listings are blocked).
Listings in restricted categories (Trust & Safety list) cannot be promoted.
Stats card displays views and chats during the promotion period compared to the equal-length prior period.
